pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with moderately smooth edge gradients and sub-angular vertices. Spatial area is relatively consistent across the mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more densely packed geometries on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-cream pathways forming a topological mesh. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent intersections, with pathway pixel thickness remaining relatively uniform throughout the visible flank and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-textured mane along the dorsal neck displaying low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations that create a jagged silhouette against the background.
